item.title: If You're Arrogant Than Everyone Else, Watch This - Schopenhauer
item.description:
You assume that being the most confident automatically wins hearts, yet true power comes from humility, not arrogance. When you act like everyone else isn't special and chase applause, you invite rejection and erode your own worth. Schopenhauer explains that craving admiration triggers anxiety, and switching to authentic connection rewires your mind, as shown when a once arrogant speaker rebuilt trust after losing fans.
